sections.name: mission
sections.value: Deliver plan 108 phase 1 — the pij Rust mold — on branch s108/rust-port in worktree /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij-worktrees/s108-rust-port. This is wave 0 of the pij CLI+daemon Rust port; fs3 plan 001 (fs3-foundations) is the pattern. You build the workspace the whole port is poured into: 8 ratified crates, six frozen ports with shipped fakes, the arch-allowlist drift gate (negative-tested), SQLite/sqlx store skeleton with boot self-migration, queue primitive, hello-depth daemon+cli single binary (pij-rs ping over localhost HTTP + per-boot bearer key), exemplar tests at every tier, rust-toolchain.toml pin, pocs/ spike lane, fixture corpus seeded with real captured pij CLI/wire traffic INCLUDING malformed cases. Small enough to solo-PM per the impl-guide fan_out note: wave 0 is one team; you code it yourself, then call the cross-model reviewer.

value.text: Read IN ORDER before any code: docs/plans/108-rust-port/plan.dd.md (the ACs are the contract) -> docs/plans/108-rust-port/services.dd.md (SETTLED interfaces + waves) -> docs/plans/108-rust-port/assets/workshops/001-architecture.md (rulings R1-R6 bind you) -> .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md -> docs/plans/108-rust-port/assets/s001-mining-notes.md (the traps, pre-paid).
Ack with a NUMBERED plan before any code; the prime rules the ack by number.

Rust layout mirrors fs3: crates/ at repo root of THIS WORKTREE (the TS code stays untouched at its paths — the two coexist; touch nothing outside crates/, pocs/, rust-toolchain.toml, root Cargo.toml, .gitignore additions, docs/plans/108-rust-port/**).

Wave-0 additions R6a-f are IN scope: toolchain pin first commit; testkit + fixture corpus BEFORE features; pocs/ template with [workspace]+.gitignore+out/ and root-manifest exclude; shared wire.rs-class module stub; fences doc naming shared-merge files; one discovery/admission component with a shared case table.

Done per unit = gate green (fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, allowlist) + prove-in-tree evidence + mutation-check on every fix-test; done reports carry observed rustc/cargo versions and Avail disk.
CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; own CARGO_TARGET_DIR if you spawn coders; absolute paths in everything.
Report at both edges of every unit (pij report now); questions to the prime pij-dominant-vicuna via pij send — product calls are the prime's, human calls are Jordan's; never ask sideways.

Dogfood flowspace3: search before grep (this worktree is indexed); report misses as friction. Log every friction to docs/plans/108-rust-port/assets/experiences.md the moment it bites (pij repo keeps its OWN log — never write into flowspace3's tree).
Prime = pij-dominant-vicuna (pane %255): rules your ack by number, receives done reports, owns merges; relays anything needing Jordan. Never ask sideways.
Reviewer: cross-model (github-copilot/gpt-5.6-sol, high) spawned AFTER composition; read-only; findings fixed or refuted with evidence.
Coders: none by default — solo-pm wave. If you argue a fan-out, propose the unit split in your ack; the prime rules it.
